meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能连接本地 Atomic Chat 桌面应用，把它运行的模型当作工具来调用：atomic_chat_list_models 列出可用模型，atomic_chat_generate 把提示发给指定模型并返回回答。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型来回答、生成内容时触发。

say.text: 使用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都。
say.note: Claude 会先列出模型，再用选中模型生成回答。

say.text: 列出 Atomic Chat 里可用的模型，然后选一个写首短诗。
say.note: 先调用列表工具，再生成诗歌回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can connect to the local Atomic Chat desktop app (API at 127.0.0.1:1337) and use its running models as tools: atomic_chat_list_models lists available models, atomic_chat_generate sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns the response.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to use Atomic Chat or a local model to answer or generate content.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Claude lists models, then picks one to generate.

say_en.text: Use the atomic_chat_generate tool to review this code with Qwen2.5-Coder.
say_en.note: Sends prompt to that local model and returns the review.

say_en.text: List available models in Atomic Chat, then pick one to write a short poem.
say_en.note: First calls list models, then generates.
